# wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account

Manage accounts of a device local domain on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.0.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete an account of a local domain of a device on a WALLIX Bastion.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account` Terraform resource.
- Passwords and SSH keys of the account are managed with [`wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account_credential`](device_localdomain_account_credential.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-account-login"></a>**account_login** | `str` | Login of the account on the device.<br>Required when the account does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-account-name"></a>**account_name** | `str` / required | Name of the account. Identifies the account in the local domain. |
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-auto-change-password"></a>**auto_change_password** | `bool` | Whether the Bastion changes the password of the account automatically.<br>The Bastion enables it when the account is created and this option is not set. |
| <a id="parameter-auto-change-ssh-key"></a>**auto_change_ssh_key** | `bool` | Whether the Bastion changes the SSH key of the account automatically.<br>The Bastion enables it when the account is created and this option is not set. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-certificate-validity"></a>**certificate_validity** | `str` | Validity of the SSH certificates generated for the account, for example `+1w2d`. |
| <a id="parameter-checkout-policy"></a>**checkout_policy** | `str` | Name of the checkout policy of the account.<br>The Bastion requires one, so `default` is used when the account is created and this option is not set, as the Terraform provider does. |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-description"></a>**description** | `str` | Description of the account. |
| <a id="parameter-device-name"></a>**device_name** | `str` / required | Name of the device. The device must exist. |
| <a id="parameter-domain-name"></a>**domain_name** | `str` / required | Name of the local domain of the device the account belongs to. The local domain must exist. |
| <a id="parameter-services"></a>**services** | `list / elements=str` | Names of the services of the device this account can be used on. Order does not matter.<br>When set, replaces all the services of the account. Use `[]` to remove them all. |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the account should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- With [`state=absent`](#parameter-state), a missing device or local domain is not an error.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Declare the root account of a server
  wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    domain_name: local
    account_name: root
    account_login: root
    services: [SSH]

- name: Stop rotating its password
  wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    domain_name: local
    account_name: root
    auto_change_password: false

- name: Remove an account
  wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    domain_name: local
    account_name: root
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-account"></a>**account** | `dict` | The account as returned by the Bastion API after the change. Secrets of its credentials are left out.<br>In check mode, the expected account. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-account) |
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated.<br><br>Returned: when the account already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["auto_change_password"]` |

<a id="sample-account"></a>

### Sample of `account`

```yaml
account_login: root
account_name: root
auto_change_password: true
auto_change_ssh_key: true
can_edit_certificate_validity: true
certificate_validity: null
checkout_policy: default
credentials:
- id: 1a0f6dbcf31a3cdb005056b66c8b
  type: password
  url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/devices/1a0f.../credentials/1a0f6dbcf31a3cdb005056b66c8b
description: ''
domain_password_change: false
id: 1a0f6dbca5e15d2b005056b66c8b
onboard_status: manual
services:
- SSH
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/devices/1a0f.../accounts/1a0f6dbca5e15d2b005056b66c8b
```
